Shreyas Iyer Blames Execution After India's Loss to West Indies

Indian cricketer Shreyas Iyer attributed the team's defeat against the West Indies in Hyderabad to a lapse in execution, stating "It All Started With Bowling." He called for sharper execution and a fresh approach following the loss, acknowledging that the team "fell a bit short."
